submittedParameters.prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL standalone full-body character master of 司马懿 for the Chinese Three Kingdoms strategy game 五行问鼎. This person is a historical/novel identity rendered in the established Taoist chibi HD hand-painted style, NOT an elemental hero and NOT an ordinary troop. Vertical2:3 canvas.
Images1 and2 are the authoritative style: rounded friendly rich hand-painted forms, ivory fabric, jade-green accents, thin warm-gold trim, cloud/ruiyi motifs, restrained red tassels. Images3 and4 are peer characters for finish and chibi proportions only; DO NOT copy either face, costume, prop or identity. Design a recognizably DIFFERENT face and silhouette.
Mature male strategist Sima Yi. Slim angular chibi face, narrower thoughtful amber eyes, high arched brows, a restrained knowing half-smile; short pointed black beard with a few silver strands and silver at temples. Black-indigo tall scholar court hat with restrained gold edging and one jade pin; layered charcoal-indigo outer robe, ivory inner sleeves, jade-green lining and cloud edging. One hand calmly holds a closed bamboo strategy scroll at his chest; other rests near a small hanging jade pendant. Upright quietly commanding stance, dignified and controlled. No feather fan, no Zhuge Liang hat, no crown of an emperor.
Stylized big head and compact short body about2.5 heads tall; rounded yet clearly adult identity and distinctive personality. All parts fully painted with fine soft shading, cloth folds and elegant gold/jade details. Three-quarter standing view facing slightly viewer-right; both complete boots visible. Entire figure including hair, crown and held prop occupies about78 percent of image height with generous clean transparent margins on ALL four sides. No cropped weapon, sleeve or tassel. True transparent native alpha background; no scene, pedestal, ground shadow, glowing halo, text, nameplate, card border, watermarks or UI. Do not use realistic anatomy, photorealism, plastic toy gloss or pixel art.
